name: Somchai Watanasuk
bio:
Somchai Watanasuk's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting in Bangkok. He quickly demonstrated a knack for understanding vehicle dynamics, spending hours tinkering with engines and chassis setups. While his driving career plateaued, his analytical abilities shone through, leading him to pursue a mechanical engineering degree. 

After graduating, Somchai joined a small GT racing team as a data analyst, quickly rising through the ranks to become a race engineer. He's known for his meticulous approach, data-driven decision-making, and ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources. His calm demeanor under pressure combined with his demanding expectations of his team make him a unique team principal, one who inspires both respect and a drive for excellence.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is a lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific blend of Thai coffee before every race.
